note: Canonical evidence file for 2024. Product terminology follows source language: US approvals are described as spot Bitcoin/Ether ETPs where appropriate rather than loosely calling every product an ETF.

events.title: SEC approves US spot Bitcoin ETP listings
events.summary: The SEC approved exchange rule changes allowing a group of spot Bitcoin exchange-traded products to list and trade in the United States.
events.significance: After more than a decade of rejected proposals, spot Bitcoin exposure entered mainstream US brokerage and asset-management infrastructure. The Grayscale court ruling was an explicit part of the changed legal circumstances cited around the approval.

sources.title: SEC — Statement on Approval of Spot Bitcoin ETPs

events.title: US spot Bitcoin ETPs begin trading
events.summary: The newly approved US spot Bitcoin ETPs began public trading on 11 January 2024. A later SEC filing by MicroStrategy cited about $4.6 billion of first-day trading volume across the products.
events.significance: The launch created a large regulated distribution channel through which traditional investors could obtain spot-linked Bitcoin exposure.

sources.title: SEC — Spot Bitcoin ETP approval statement
MicroStrategy SEC filing citing first-day ETP trading

events.title: Ethereum Dencun activates blobs and EIP-4844
events.summary: Ethereum activated Cancun-Deneb at epoch 269,568, introducing blob-carrying transactions through EIP-4844 alongside other execution and consensus changes.
events.significance: Dencun dramatically lowered data costs for rollups and made blobspace a central piece of Ethereum's L2-centric scaling architecture.

events.title: BlackRock launches BUIDL tokenized fund on Ethereum
events.summary: BlackRock launched the BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund (BUIDL), its first tokenized fund issued on a public blockchain, with Securitize providing tokenization infrastructure.
events.significance: BUIDL became a landmark convergence of traditional asset management, tokenized US-dollar/Treasury exposure and public-blockchain settlement.

sources.title: BlackRock / Business Wire release syndicated by Nasdaq — BUIDL launch

events.title: Bitcoin's fourth halving cuts subsidy to 3.125 BTC
events.summary: At block 840,000, Bitcoin's block subsidy fell from 6.25 BTC to 3.125 BTC.
events.significance: The fourth halving continued Bitcoin's fixed monetary issuance schedule and arrived during an era of spot ETP demand and industrial-scale mining.

events.title: Runes protocol launches at Bitcoin block 840,000
events.summary: Casey Rodarmor's UTXO-based fungible-token protocol Runes activated at block 840,000, the same block as Bitcoin's fourth halving.
events.significance: Runes extended Bitcoin's post-Ordinals token experimentation and produced intense competition for historically significant halving-block space and transaction fees.

events.title: SEC approves exchange rule changes for spot Ether ETPs
events.summary: The SEC granted accelerated approval to proposed exchange rule changes for listing and trading shares of several Ether-based exchange-traded products.
events.significance: The approval created the regulatory pathway for US spot Ether ETP trading and extended mainstream exchange-traded crypto exposure beyond Bitcoin.

sources.title: SEC — Order approving Ether-based ETP rule changes

events.title: US spot Ether ETPs begin trading
events.summary: US spot Ether exchange-traded products began trading on 23 July 2024 following registration effectiveness and the May exchange-rule approvals.
events.significance: Ether became directly accessible through regulated US spot-linked exchange-traded products, broadening institutional crypto-market infrastructure.

sources.title: Grayscale SEC-filed release — ETH and ETHE begin trading

events.title: Mt. Gox begins Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash repayments
events.summary: The Mt. Gox rehabilitation trustee announced commencement of repayments in Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash in mid-2024, beginning distributions through designated exchanges after roughly a decade of creditor proceedings.
events.significance: Creditors finally began receiving crypto from the most famous exchange collapse of Bitcoin's early history, closing a major chapter of the 2014 disaster.

events.title: Bitcoin breaks its prior all-time high before the halving
events.summary: Bitcoin reached a record $69,202 on the Reuters-referenced market data on 5 March 2024, exceeding the November 2021 peak before the fourth halving had occurred.
events.significance: It was the first Bitcoin cycle in which a new nominal all-time high arrived before the corresponding halving, amid strong demand through newly launched US spot ETPs.

sources.title: Reuters — Bitcoin rises to record high

events.notes: Use source-specific price because spot highs vary by venue/index.

events.title: EigenLayer and EigenDA launch on mainnet
events.summary: Eigen Labs launched EigenLayer's operator/AVS mainnet functionality and EigenDA on 9 April 2024 after restaking had already attracted more than 4.1 million ETH.
events.significance: EigenLayer turned Ethereum restaking into a major new crypto security market and launched the shared-security/Actively Validated Services narrative.

sources.title: Eigen Labs — Mainnet Launch Announcement: EigenLayer ∞ EigenDA

events.title: Eigen Foundation announces EIGEN token and stakedrop
events.summary: The Eigen Foundation announced the EIGEN token and Season 1 'stakedrop,' initially making EIGEN non-transferable and allocating tokens to ecosystem participants.
events.significance: The distribution became one of the highest-profile examples of the points-and-airdrop model surrounding restaking in 2024.

sources.title: Eigen Foundation — EIGEN token and Season 1 stakedrop

events.title: WazirX loses more than $230 million in multisig-wallet cyberattack
events.summary: WazirX reported a cyberattack against a multisig wallet using third-party custody infrastructure, with stolen digital assets exceeding $230 million. Deposits and withdrawals were halted as the exchange investigated and pursued recovery.
events.significance: The attack became one of the largest exchange thefts of 2024 and a major crisis for India's crypto market.

events.title: Saxony completes emergency sale of nearly 50,000 seized BTC
events.summary: The Dresden Public Prosecutor General's Office said authorities sold approximately 49,858 BTC seized in the Movie2k case between 19 June and 12 July 2024, provisionally securing €2.6397 billion.
events.significance: The sale became one of the largest government disposals of Bitcoin and a highly visible example of sovereign law-enforcement holdings entering the market.
